items.desc: On Episode 3 of Miris Gala we have Manheim Fowles gracing the soundwaves, a selector known for his eclectic and hard hitting track selections tethering tension and release. Having been introduced to EDM by his siblings at a young age and to Latin sounds introduced by now dear-friends passing through town, Manheim has solidified his position within Boorloo's creative scene as a true tastemaker. Pulling across genres spanning the globe, prepare yourself for a fast-paced and club ready mix of EDM, Latin-core, UK, deconstructed club sounds, and much more.
items.title: Miris Gala Ep. 3 w/ Manheim Fowles

items.desc: In the 6th course of 8theclub’s mixology series, Graham and P33don are joined by Sofi. Sofi is a bass-driven DJ with an instinct for the dance floor. Her sound weaves together UK and Latin American influences that are percussion rich and bass heavy. She moves effortlessly through an array of genres and club edits, creating sets that are playful, dynamic and built to keep bodies moving.
items.title: 8theclub Mixology Ep 6 w/ Sofi

items.desc: Ayo Busari sits down with colleague and collaborator Kate Naunton Morgan, a model, actor and marketing creative, for Episode 2 of Joy Tapes Vol. 1. They chat about Kate’s creative journey, life beyond the work, finding joy, and WA’s creative community, alongside music that brings her joy and tracks from Ayo’s latest EP, Joy & Balloons.
items.title: Joy Tapes Ep. 2 w/ Kate Naunton Morgan

items.desc: Heads down, thumbs up. Bordering the line between functional and dysfunctional, Lia joins Andrew this week to plumb the depths of what can make your body move!
items.title: Functional Dance Music Ep. 4 w/ Andrew & Lia T

items.desc: In the second instalment of Miris Gala, Nathaara welcomes none other than her first guest in multi-hyphenate Libra superstar AGAPANTHA for an hour of big bass, spacious breaks and experimentation through a sonic reflection into her travels and ancestry. Bringing global rhythms and sounds from Boorloo all the way to the South Americas in a delightful ride through the hemispheres, enter into a portal of high energy electronica, techno, deconstructed club sounds, organic textures and more.
items.title: Miris Gala Ep. 2 w/ Agapantha

items.desc: Joy Tapes is a three-volume RTR2 residency hosted by Ayo Busari, bringing together WA artists and creatives for candid conversations about their creative journeys, the people behind their practice, community, and what joy means to them. Blending conversation and music, each episode moves between the personal and creative, featuring songs selected by each guest alongside tracks from Ayo’s discography. At its heart, Joy Tapes is about discovering the stories, sounds and moments of joy that shape the people making art in WA. Ayo kicks off Joy Tapes Vol. 1 with good friend and frequent collaborat…
items.title: Joy Tapes Volume 1 Ep. 1 w/Prince Attwood

items.desc: For his entry into the RTR2 canon, Recycler keeps steady pressure on the accelerator for two club focused hours inspired by the sights and sounds he’s recently taken in on dancefloors and club green rooms, moving though fidgety tech house and minimal techno, proto-electro clash and contemporary revivals of progressive house. Tune in, switch off and lock in.
items.title: Rapid Electrical Impulses Ep. 1 w/ Recycler

items.desc: RTR2 residents combine forces for the love of Functional Dance Music! Connor aka Gibbo (aka Vertigo co-founder!) joins Andrew behind the decks for their debut B2B set together. Lock in for a suitable amount of tension and release across two trippy trance-inducing hours with music that'll keep you on your toes and take you somewhere else.
items.title: Functional Dance Music Ep. 3 w/ Andrew & Gibbo

items.desc: On the 5th serving of Mixology, 8theclub welcomes Top vs Btm for a takeover episode. Both Graham and Pluto have combined forces and their love for underground music, as Top vs Btm. With a focus on techno, electro, bass, baile and prog house in their duo's debut mix, you can expect to hear strong grooves, strange rhythms and genre bending. Prepare for a fluctuation of energy and get to know Top vs Btm, as they interview one another. Can you work out who's who?
items.title: 8theclub Mixology Ep. 5 w/ Top vs Btm

items.desc: Vertigo presents the third install in its mix series on RTR2, brought to you again by one of its own operators, gadgets and all. Calculatingly discombobulating, b0rk microwaves a smorgasbord of mischievous minimal and post tech-house (talk of the town), with sprinklings of grand-theft breaks, barnyard jazz, and some techno razzle dazzle. Post up with your finest fedora!
items.title: Vertigo Ep 3 w/ b0rk

items.desc: This week on RTR2 we're back at the Functional Dance Music headquarters with Andrew and the enigmatic Sarah! If you were around WA's darkest dancefloors around five years ago, there would have been a mysterious figure pumping out club-ready tunes and turning the dancefloor into a pit of activity... Searching high and low, Andrew has tracked down the slick selector, Sarah; the one who in fact coined the phrase 'Functional Dance Music'! Strap in for a bass-heavy, acid-trippy ride across two entrancing hours where the duo's love of dancing permeates every song choice. And what is Functional Danc…
items.title: Functional Dance Music Ep. 2 w/ Andrew & Sarah

items.desc: The Water's Never Dry returns to RTR2 after a little hiatus, this time with the delightful wetpuddlss exploring tracks seemingly out of context and finding threads between them. Expect the unexpected in this adventure-hopping two hour journey of house, techno, and maybe a little of your parents record collection!
items.title: The Water's Never Dry Ep. 5 w/ wetpuddlss

items.desc: Born and raised between Auckland and Kuala Lumpur, and now lovingly tethered to Boorloo, Nathaara’s foray into sound selection sits squarely at the intersection of deep cultural appreciation and an impulse to boundary-push. In her new RTR2 Residency ‘Miris Gala’ (මිරිස් ගල), she lifts the lid on her playful and percussive tastes, ranging from dapke to jungle to Bollywood and beyond. Peek in for a mix filled to the brim with a proclivity for texture and most importantly... hip shaking.
items.title: Miris Gala Ep. 1 w/ Nathaara

items.desc: Andrew Walsh presents the Functional Dance Music series on RTR2! For the opening installment, Andrew welcomes his good friend Daniel Rechichi, aka Good Fortune, for a B2B set of wiggly wobbly basslines and transportive grooves that captures the spirit of Functional Dance Music. With the mood set by a fine charcuterie platter (thanks Sarah!), join Andrew and Daniel for a special meeting of musical minds that spans deeper house grooves and upbeat tech-driven moments from their enviable record collections!
items.title: Functional Dance Music Ep. 1 w/ Good Fortune

items.desc: Join Sacha Alexiou on this all-wax escapade through his collection. It’s definitely for dancing. Expect the unexpected as we progress through dub, progressive, electro, house, and techno. Anything goes... Remember that!
items.title: Sacha Alexiou Ep. 1

items.desc: This week we’re in for a treat thanks to Vertigo on RTR2, with a collection of (mostly) minimal music that has blessed Bowen’s ears in recent months. For the love of tech-house.... this mix is not for dancing! Settle in with a cuppa for a deeper listening, immersive experience.
items.title: Vertigo Ep. 2 w/ Bowen

items.desc: Boorloo-based DJ, creative and longtime RTRFM volunteer Cody, aka c.brom, hops onto the RTR2 airwaves for a very special guest mix! Over the course of two hours, Cody dives into musical rabbit holes permeating dub techno and pieces of prog, all while drawing on a wide range of organic influences from nature, bugs and the ocean. A constant theme runs throughout; learning to slow down, inspiration from friends and navigating the depths of one's brain!
items.title: c.brom Ep. 1

items.desc: 8theclub’s mixology series with Graham and P33don on RTR2 welcomes MrsPlow for a cup of tea and some chats about her art, vinyls, and journey as a DJ. Whether you've seen her light up dancefloors at parties across Boorloo, or reveled in her art (@huggypot) featuring on posters for the likes of Nest FM and Midnight Elevator, Mrs Plow is an incredibly gifted selector and artist in equal measure. In her first recorded mix after a long hiatus, she pushes the boundaries of trance and progressive house mixing both vinyl and digital, with long sexy build ups, beautiful synth leads and wobbly basslin…
items.title: 8theclub Mixology Ep. 4 w/ Mrs Plow

items.desc: RTR2's spotlight on RTRFM's FWD RWD sets continues this week, showcasing Naarm-via-Boorloo DJ Proc's impeccable selections and skills behind the controllers. Tune in for an hour of low end frequencies spanning techno, dub house, club-forward hip shakers and a sprinkling of garage!
items.title: Proc at FWD RWD 2024

items.desc: Things heat up in Punk Village with intrepid explorers Chris Shoulder (Gaffer, Structure, DiE, Bees Make Honey, Worker, Shivved et al) and Elizabeta as they give you more mayhem for your money, which, by the way, is no good here.
items.title: Elizabeta Ep. 4 - Quizmaster General Meets Stan the Man in Punkland

items.desc: Boorloo-based electronic producers Ben Agüero and Sleepthink (aka the moniker project of Ethan Reed) transported us to flow state during their ambient and experimental sets launching RTRFM's newest music program, Subterranea, recorded live at PS Art Space in September 2025. This special live recording blends sonic liminal space, inter-dimensional glitches, and wistful synthesizer sounds that'll glide you through celestial territories and higher realms. Think light at the end of the tunnel!
items.title: Subterranea w/ Ben Agüero & sleepthink Live at PS Art Space

items.desc: For the third and final installment of Britt Bro’s Desert Frog Dub Triptych, we’ve gone down the ambient waterhole and quantum frog-leapt onto a crisp June dancefloor in Mparntwe, swimming in froggy-proggy-house, deep, minimal, and dub techno.
items.title: Desert Frog Dub Triptych Ep. 3 w/ Britt Bro

items.desc: After a little hiatus... the ONO show returns to RTR2! Packing a mixed bag of twisted favourites old and new. Echoes on the mic, big ups the 6003... phones are back baby!
items.title: ONO Records Ep. 5 w/ Ernest & Young

items.desc: For the first edition of the Vertigo mix series, RTR2 welcomes up to the podium label & promoter co-runner Connor; making his way through reverberating low end frequencies and a buttery mix of minimal, tech house, techno & some other eccentric bits and bobs he managed to slide in there. Two hours of fun delivered from Vertigo directly to your ears, enjoy!
items.title: Vertigo Ep. 1 w/ Connor

items.desc: The third dish served by 8theclub mixology has been prepared by guest Duel1st. In this episode Graham and P33don are joined by Duel1st for some chats about music, events and more. Kyle Van Dyk known by his alias Duel1st is a Boorloo-based up and coming DJ. Being highly influenced by the local underground and alternative music scene, Duel1st has cultivated a wide interest in electronic and dance music through local acts and artists. Duel1st has shown a steady foray into alternative and experimental sounds and aims to further develop a unique listening experience.
items.title: 8theclub Mixology Ep. 3 w/ Duel1st
